newsitem.title: UK: BOE sets $2.0 bln five-year FRN.
newsitem.headline: BOE sets $2.0 bln five-year FRN.

text.p: The Bank of England announced on Thursday the issue by the British government of a $2.0 billion five-year FRN.
The FRN has a coupon of 1/8 percent under three-month dollar LIBID. It will be offered at a margin of 19 basis points below three-month dollar LIBOR.
The issue is underwritten and managed by BZW with HSBC Markets and NatWest Markets as joint-lead managers.
The issue will be settled on October 4 1996, and maturing in October 2001.
The deal, callable at par on coupon dates from October 1999, is being reoffered at its 99.745 issue price.
